transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, I guess what brought me in is... I kind of lost control of things at work recently. I'm a landscaper, usually just a regular crew guy, but I went from that to suddenly trying to run three different bids at once. I was calling city officials, trying to line up all these plant suppliers, and just messaging everybody I knew about this massive park idea I had. It was like I just couldn't shut it off, you know? I was going a hundred miles an hour and couldn't stop.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt the opposite—very down, depressed, or lacking energy for weeks at a time?

I mean... I don't really think so. I get tired sometimes, just from the physical work, but... I haven't really noticed feeling down or lacking energy for weeks at a time like you're saying. I'm not really sure I've ever had a period like that.
Have you ever had a time before this where you felt this kind of extreme energy or racing thoughts?

No, I don't think so. This was... this was pretty new for me. I mean, I usually just show up, do my job, and go home. I've never really had my brain just take off like that before, where I couldn't stop it. So, no, nothing like this in the past.
During this time, did you hear or see anything that other people couldn't see or hear?

No, nothing like that. I didn't hear voices or see things or anything. It was really just... my own thoughts, you know? Just moving way too fast and getting out of hand. But I wasn't seeing things that weren't actually there.
Did you have any new physical illness or medical condition around the time this started?
No, I don't think so. I'm pretty healthy, honestly. I didn't get sick or have any kind of new medical issues going on when this all started.
Around the time this started, were you taking any medications, supplements, or recreational drugs?

No, I wasn't taking anything. I don't really take medications, not even for headaches most of the time. And I don't use drugs or take any kind of supplements or anything like that. So, no, nothing in my system.
How long did this period of high energy and racing thoughts last?

It lasted about two weeks. That whole fired-up, overconfident stretch started when I began remaking myself for this park pitch I wanted to do. So yeah, it went on for right around two weeks before I just... crashed.
